english.note: Use this for an ongoing recent stretch around now, especially in the sense of “these days” or “lately.”
Use this for “these days” when the recent period is understood as the speaker's current situation.

examples.english: I have been very busy recently.
examples.jyutping: ni1 paai4 ngo5 dou1 hou2 mong4
ni1 paai4 ngo5 dou1 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2
